status: Fixed in source; frozen runner publication and formal closeout remain separate states
area: Cross-task mutation guard / terminal task-history reconciliation
finding: A normal live successor task can receive a bounded work-admission ticket for terminal task-history paths, but terminal-history-entitlement ignored that task's own live ledger and accepted only a framework temporary lock with linkedTaskId. Ordinary successor cleanup cards are not created with linkedTaskId, so every exact-scope attempt was rejected as terminal-unentitled by the pre-commit hook.
expectedBehavior: A live task claim that explicitly and narrowly covers a terminal history path is an answerable successor review surface and may reconcile that path. A framework temporary claim remains ineligible without an explicit linkedTaskId. Missing ledgers, broad scopes, inactive writers, and live terminal owners remain fail-closed.
evidenceOrRepro: TASK-TMP-0013 claimed 129 exact released-history paths through a valid atm.workAdmissionTicket.v1, including .atm/history/task-events/ATM-GOV-0253/**. Governed commit was rejected with ATM_CROSS_TASK_MUTATION_BLOCKED / terminal-unentitled because .atm/runtime/locks/TASK-TMP-0013.lock.json had linkedTaskId=null. The focused test first failed against the old rule, then passed after the repair; it also preserves the negative framework-temporary-without-linkage case.
containment: The repair requires both an existing live task ledger and a bounded matching scope entry before self-anchoring the writer. It does not grant a framework-temporary writer self-entitlement, and it does not admit any path excluded from the task's governed scope.
followUp: Rebuild and publish the frozen runner through the normal governed runner-sync route before ordinary frozen CLI sessions rely on this repair. Reclaim TASK-TMP-0013 with its exact history scope and retry the governed commit; do not use raw Git bypass.
